description: Checks Shodan's passive scan records for TCP port 445 (SMB) on an IPv4 address. Says whether SMB was seen open and when the record was last refreshed by the host data (not a live test). An address with no Shodan record returns seen=false with known=false; that is not proof the port is closed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_smb_exposure_test
title: Security Smb Exposure Test
